description:
GISGP Lite ($6 a month, $3 for 7 days, or $1 once for 24 hours) — pass the api_key of that
    account (or Authorization: Bearer). which coordinate
    reference system puts these easting/northing rows where they belong. `lines` are text rows
    such as "P-7 690183.66, 4729859.76" (up to 1,000); say roughly where with `country` ("Kenya")
    or `lat`/`lon`. Returns JSON {ok, confidence: high|medium|low|none, candidates: [{epsg, name,
    area, swapped, national, km, lat, lon}], rows, bad_rows}. Then convert with the chosen EPSG via
    reproject_geojson or /api/v1/crs/apply.
name: guess_crs
